info.title: Event Management System API
info.description:
Complete REST API for Event Management & Coordination with RBAC

**Authentication:**

Authenticated endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`.

**Demo Users:**

- SuperAdmin: superadmin@example.com / Admin@123
- Client: client@example.com / Client@123
- Organizer: organizer@example.com / Organizer@123
- Staff: staff@example.com / Staff@123
- Attendee: attendee@example.com / Attendee@123

organizerId.description: Organizer ID to send request to

message.description: Query / question requesting missing information from the client
message.example: Could you specify the preferred AV equipment and catering dietary preferences?

response.description: Client response to the missing info request
response.example: We require 3 wireless microphones, 4K projector, and 20% vegetarian meals.

terms.example: Includes full day hall rental, standard audio setup, and buffet catering.

notes.example: Deposit required within 7 days of agreement to lock the venue.

revisionReason.example: Adjusted catering options and reduced deposit per client request.

reason.description: Reason for a permanent rejection or requested change

proposedBudget.description: Proposed budget when requesting a budget change

proposedDate.description: Proposed date when requesting a date change

decision.description: Client decision on the proposal or request

notes.description: Feedback or notes from the client
notes.example: We accept the proposal terms and are ready to sign agreement.

agreementConfirmed.description: Force confirm agreement if verified out-of-band

depositConfirmed.description: Force confirm deposit if verified out-of-band

clientId.description: Client ID (derived from the event request)

organizerId.description: Organizer ID (derived from the event request)

description.example: Complete event plan including speakers and schedule

reason.description: Reason for requesting a revised plan
